name: Promotion of Exportable surplus of identified spices in NE: Cultivation of Lakadong turmeric (Ha)
benefit: 1. 50% of cost of planting material subject to maximum of ₹ 30,000 per Ha 1. Turmeric growers of NE having land holding size of 0.10 Ha to 8 Ha
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicable to turmeric growers in Sikkim, Darjeeling & Kalimpong district of West Bengal, and other North Eastern States. 1. Eligible cases will be finalized based on inspection and recommendation by designated officials.
